All 18 rules were searched across the full document and the plan is submitted.

Highlights for the reviewing team:

- **Likely deviations to examine first:** SOW § 2.0 renewal (p0658) requires twelve months' notice against six-month renewal periods; no standalone termination-for-convenience right for IBM in the Base Agreement; no general vendor insurance article; the § 9.0 non-solicit (p0189) binds us and needs a carve-out check.
- **Clauses in our favour (do not flag):** MSL's IP assignment (p0197-p0198), the "most favored customer" engineering pricing (p1099), MSL-side delinquency adjustments/penalties (p0749-p0757), and all located audit rights, which run against MSL.
- **Cross-document duplicates preserved:** governing law appears in three instruments (p0300, p1499, p1587); liability limits in both § 15.3 and the Loan Agreement § 15; indemnities in § 15.1 plus Attachment 6.
